events.verdict: Markkanen (UTA) firms up in a screening position in Rozier's (MIA) path and the contact is incidental as Markkanen rolls towards the basket.
Rozier (MIA) cleanly dislodges the ball from Flipowski's (UTA) possession.

Herro (MIA) moves forwards into Collier (UTA), causing him to lose his balance. The illegal contact occurs before the start of Collier's upward shooting motion and is correctly assessed as a non-shooting foul.
Adebayo (MIA) is in a legal guarding position and the incidental contact is created by Collier (UTA) during his driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Kessler (UTA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Kessler obtains a legal guarding position and jumps vertically, absorbing the contact initiated by Jaquez Jr. (MIA). Neither team was in imminent possession of the ball during the point of interruption and therefore, play resumes with a jump ball.
Collier (UTA) commits a take foul on Jaquez Jr. (MIA).
Herro (MIA) leans into Collier (UTA), but the contact is marginal and Collier is not dislodged from his position as a result of the contact.
Collier (UTA) commits a take foul on Herro (MIA).
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) deflects Filipowski's (UTA) pass, causing the ball to go out of bounds.
Play is stopped due to a clock malfunction.
Although Sexton (UTA) is already beginning to lose his balance, Rozier (MIA) continues moving forwards into him and initiates illegal contact.
Kessler (UTA) commits a take foul on Jaquez Jr. (MIA).
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) legally contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
